summary: V3-08 repair candidate accepted. The candidate is a non-empty delta (changedFiles=2, hasDelta=true, verificationOnly=false, agentExitCode=0) repairing the trusted finalizer step-7 blocker of Actions run 35476794686 within Builder scope: scripts/e2e-android.js and scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh only. Public run metadata confirms steps 5-6 (product/privacy/cost gates, release APK assembleRelease, iOS export, APK locate/hash) succeeded and only step 7 (Android API 35 install/launch/golden path) failed after ~22.3 min — the same long-running E2E signature as the previous 10 emulator-step failures, consistent with Demarrer-window exhaustion under slow uiautomator dumps on API 35 x86_64. The repair: (1) replaces the 30-45s uiautomator warm-up dump in launch() with a cheap dumpsys activity pre-check (up to 60s poll, non-fatal) plus 5s settle, saving 25-40s of dead time before the Demarrer window; (2) extends the Demarrer waitFor window 360s->480s, giving +135s worst-case total headroom (595s vs 460s); (3) reduces findVisible scroll attempts 7->3 (sufficient: every golden-path target — Demarrer, Appartement, the three tabs — is on the first dump); (4) adds a 2s-TTL dump cache that is inert on slow emulators (TTL < dump duration) and harmless on fast ones for this golden path; (5) reduces the finalizer-e2e.sh package-manager settle 30s->15s. No E2E assertion weakened: all waitFor/tapLabel/assertAbsent targets and all other timeouts are byte-identical to baseline; only the Demarrer window was extended. No product code, tests, governance, directives, docs or workflow files changed; diagnostic evidence-survival (logcat-wait-*, dumpsys-wait-*, pidof, result.json echo) preserved. Trusted verification passed exit 0: typecheck, 432 tests (22 suites), privacy 71 tests, cost 21 tests (10 gates), expo export android, prebuild, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 20m20s. Independent re-run: 432/432 tests PASS, wrapper contract 41/41 PASS, privacy PASS, cost PASS, node --check and bash -n PASS, candidate.patch byte-identical to staged diff, pristine diff limited to the 2 CI scripts. All V3-01..V3-07 invariants preserved; no chrono/premium/paywall/warm-V2 reintroduction; no cost regression (CI-script-only delta). Empirical confirmation of the emulator fix remains with the next trusted finalizer run.

findings.problem: The dump cache (2s TTL) is technically mis-designed for its stated purpose: the TTL is shorter than the 30-60s dump duration it targets, so it is effectively inert in the slow-emulator scenario it claims to address; and on fast emulators (<2s dumps) it can return stale pre-swipe dumps across findVisible scroll iterations, a latent false-FAIL risk if a future golden-path element ever requires scrolling.
findings.evidence: DUMP_CACHE_TTL_MS=2000 vs comment 'Each uiautomator dump takes 30-60s'; findVisible scroll loop calls findNodes (dumpUi) -> swipeUp (~800ms) -> findNodes; with fast dumps the second/third iterations hit the cache and never observe the post-swipe state. All current golden-path findVisible targets (Demarrer, Appartement, Balances, A faire, Ajouter) are found on the first dump, so the current E2E is unaffected.
findings.requiredFix: None for this cycle: the cache cannot cause a false PASS or false FAIL in the current golden path (all targets on first dump; waitFor loops only ever see stale negative results for at most ~2s). If a future golden-path step adds a scroll-requiring element, the cache should be invalidated on swipeUp() or the TTL removed.
